title: Charli xcx Hosting ‘Music, Fashion, Film’ Album Listening Parties in 25 Cities Around the World
summary: U.S. Fans in New York, Los Angeles, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Miami, Santa Cruz, Phoenix, Seattle and Denver will have a chance to hear the singer's upcoming seventh album first.
contentText:
Charli xcx is giving her biggest fans a chance to hear her upcoming seventh studio album before the rest of the world. On Monday (July 6), the singer announced plans to host 25 Music, Fashion Film listening events across the globe in independent movie houses in North America, the U.K., Europe, Brazil, Japan, Australia and New Zealand.

“ i wanna play you my album ,” the singer wrote in Instagram in the announcement of the events slated to take place Thursday (July 9) through Saturday (July 11). In keeping with her indie film vibe, Charli will host the listening parties at North American repertory houses including Chicago’s Century Centre Cinema, New York’s Metrograph and Village East By Angelika, Atlanta’s Midtown Arts Cinema and Los Angeles’ Nuart Theater.

There will also be North American screenings in Boston, Miami, Santa Cruz, Calif., Phoenix, Seattle, Denver and Toronto. Other parties will take place in London, Manchester, São Paulo, Mexico City, Madrid, Milan, Brussels, Amsterdam, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Melbourne, Auckland and Tokyo; details about the screenings can be found here .

Charli’s follow-up to her smash 2024 album Brat is due out on July 24. So far, she’s released the singles “Wink Wink,” “Rock Music” and “SS26” and announced the dates for a North American arena tour slated to kick off on Sept. 11 at Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia. The outing will also feature a two-night stand at Barclays Center in Brooklyn and stops in Toronto, Boston, Washington, D.C., Atlanta, San Diego, Los Angeles and Glendale, Ariz. before winding down on Oct. 23 at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas.
